english.title: Fail to display registered name continuously for fifteen seconds
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were

(A)_[a company which,]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), who was in default, the company having,]_

without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a requirement that its registered name, at an office, place or location shared by six or more companies, was

(C)_[displayed for at least fifteen continuous seconds at least once every three minutes]_
(D)_[available for inspection on a register by any visitor to that office, place or location]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 23(3) and 28 of the Company, Limited Liability Partnership and Business (Names and Trading Disclosures) Regulations 2015.
